row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (pricing page is a Get Pricing form)
row.evidence: Teleport's SCIM docs state "Identity Governance is available only with Teleport Enterprise," and the feature matrix lists SCIM provisioning as "Available In Teleport Identity Governance" with no Community Edition support; the pricing page publishes no prices.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). The pricing page no longer shows a Team plan or any prices, only a Get Pricing form ('Pay only for what you use: active users and protected resources'); the June Team price (~$12-18/resource/mo) has no first-party source now and was dropped. Current plans per docs: Community Edition (free, restricted to companies under 100 employees and $10M revenue), Enterprise (Cloud) and Enterprise (Self-Hosted). SAML/OIDC SSO is Enterprise-only (Community supports GitHub SSO only). SCIM needs the Identity Governance product on Enterprise plus a configured SAML connector. Okta deprovisioning deletes the Teleport user and creates a session lock. Entra ID uses a Teleport-run Microsoft Graph user/group sync, not SCIM. Admin API is gRPC (Go client, tctl, Terraform), not REST.

scim.base_url: https://{tenant}.teleport.sh/v1/webapi/scim/okta (Okta); generic SCIM base URL is shown in the Web UI

auth.token_source: Web UI > Add new integration > SCIM > SCIM Credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, Base URL); Okta: Zero Trust Access > Integrations > Okta > SCIM tile (API Token, bearer)
auth.notes: Generic SCIM uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials; the Okta integration uses a bearer API token that is invalidated when the SCIM configuration is re-saved.

endpoints.notes: Teleport does not publish a SCIM endpoint reference; Users and Groups are inferred from the user provisioning (Okta) and group-membership (generic) guides. SailPoint schema discovery is mentioned but /Schemas is not named.

operations.notes: Deactivation deletes the user; re-provisioning recreates the user and revokes the lock. Group push maps to pre-created SCIM-type Access Lists only.

deprovision.data_retained: Teleport user is deleted and a lock is created that terminates sessions and blocks already-issued credentials; the lock is revoked if the user is re-provisioned.

custom.how: All attributes sent (except password) are stored in an internal user label and echoed back in SCIM responses; none are mapped to Teleport user traits.

roles.how: Roles are granted by Teleport Access Lists; SCIM group displayName maps 1:1 to a SCIM-type Access List whose grants hold the roles. Okta-provisioned users get the default okta-requester role.

rate_limits.text: Defaults (Teleport v18.9.2+): average 600 requests per 60 s window, burst 1200, max 300 concurrent mutating operations, per Auth Service instance; HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded; configurable per SCIM plugin (v18.10.1+).

limitations.text: Okta provisioning is To App only; importing from Teleport to Okta is not supported.
Okta does not send suspensions, so suspended Okta users keep existing sessions and credentials.
Only SCIM-type Access Lists created in advance (e.g. via Terraform) can be managed; group displayName must exactly match the Access List title.
SCIM attributes are not shown in the UI and are stored in an internal label subject to change.

auth.notes: Access is governed by Teleport RBAC roles on the API user, not OAuth scopes.

capabilities.notes: Documented via tctl (users add/ls/rm, edit user), which uses the same gRPC API; groups are Access Lists (Identity Governance, Enterprise). User locks are the closest thing to deactivation.

audit_log_api.notes: Clients can subscribe to audit events through the gRPC API; the Event Handler plugin exports them to SIEMs on all editions.

limitations.text: The API is gRPC (Go client) with TLS certificate auth; no REST user endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked; Group Push is not checked on the OIN page although Teleport's legacy custom-app steps enable Push Groups.

entra.notes: Teleport-run user and group import over Microsoft Graph; no Entra gallery tutorial for Teleport was found (Learn tutorial URLs 404).

google.notes: Teleport documents Google Workspace as an SSO provider only; no Google catalogue page checked.

onelogin.notes: From Teleport's own OneLogin SSO guide; OneLogin's catalogue not checked.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud guide covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Teleport-run Okta user sync (Okta API) and Entra ID user/group sync (Microsoft Graph)
